key: ["Babur comes down from Kabul with matchlocks, field guns and the horsemen of Central Asia. For the better part of two centuries his descendants rule from Kabul to the Deccan. Akbar builds the administration, Shah Jahan the monuments, Aurangzeb the wars that stretch it all to breaking. By 1700 the empire is at its largest. Within fifty years the Marathas hold the centre, Nawabs rule Bengal and Awadh, and a trading company has an army of its own.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
